Welcome!

I'm Laurens Weitkamp, a machine learning engineer interested in sequential decision making, computer vision, and multimodal models.

I currently work for [Qualcomm AI Research](https://www.qualcomm.com/research/artificial-intelligence) as a research engineer. Previously, I was at [Thirona](https://thirona.eu/), training deep 3D neural networks for medical lung imaging.

My academic background is mostly in Reinforcement Learning (RL), with a slight focus on vision and [learning hierarchical policies](https://scripties.uba.uva.nl/search?id=record_29279). I also once [published a paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1902.00566) on explainable RL.
